text:
Predicates:
NetflixShow(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
Popular(x) ::: x is popular.
BingeWatch(x, y) ::: x binge-watches y.
Download(x, y) ::: x downloads y.
Share(x, y) ::: x shares y with y's friend.
Karen ::: Karen (constant).
Lisa ::: Lisa (constant).
BlackMirror ::: "Black Mirror" (constant).
Premises:
∀x (NetflixShow(x) ∧ Popular(x) → BingeWatch(Karen, x)) ::: If a Netflix show x is popular, then Karen binge-watches it.
∀x (BingeWatch(Karen, x) ↔ Download(Karen, x)) ::: Karen binge-watches a Netflix show if and only if she downloads it.
¬Download(Karen, BlackMirror) ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
NetflixShow(BlackMirror) ::: "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
∀x (BingeWatch(Karen, x) → Share(Karen, Lisa, x)) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show x, she shares it with Lisa.
Conclusion:
Karen shares("Stranger Things", Lisa) ::: Karen shares "Stranger Things" with Lisa.
